After recently enabling iPhone users to add a second account within the same app, WhatsApp is now planning to expand support to up to three accounts. Here are the details.

WhatsApp to support up to three accounts

Last June, WhatsApp officially launched multi-account support on iPhone, allowing users to add a second account within the same app.

After several months of Beta testing, the feature was officially rolled out, giving users an alternative to relying on WhatsApp Business as a workaround for managing a second account.

According to WABetaInfo, the app is now planning to expand this feature, allowing users to switch between up to three accounts without needing to log out.

WABetaInfo reports:

The report adds that each account will retain its own chat history, notifications, privacy settings, backups, and media.

WABetaInfo notes that while two accounts may be sufficient for many users, the feature will be very useful for those who have different combinations of work and personal phone numbers.

That said, the feature is still in development and has not yet been made available to Beta testers, meaning it may still be some time before a wider rollout.
